name: Muramite Industrial: Refinery
summary: A Discord‑charged refinery where raw ore, arcane slag, and fissure‑extracted materials are purified and processed.
description: The Refinery is the Muramite Dominion’s primary processing center for Discord‑tainted ore and arcane slag. Massive furnaces roar with unstable energy, purification vats bubble with volatile reagents, and conveyor lines carry refined warsteel toward the Foundry. Reactor Wardens monitor arcane contamination levels while Muramite overseers enforce brutal labor discipline. Discord manifestations are common, born from unstable refining processes.
